scripts.dev: npm run build -w @fieldissue/shared && npm run dev -w @fieldissue/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fieldissue/shared && npm run build -w @fieldissue/api && npm run build -w @fieldissue/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @fieldissue/shared && npm run test -w @fieldissue/api
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @fieldissue/shared && npm run lint -w @fieldissue/api && prettier --check apps/api/src apps/api/test apps/api/vitest.config.ts packages/shared/src && npm run typecheck -w @fieldissue/web
